data.name: Birdshot
data.detailed_description:
Birdshot is a third‑person upland and waterfowl hunting game that captures the excitement of flushing birds in open fields and calling mallards into a marsh blind. Move through atmospheric landscapes, follow your dog, and take fast, instinctive shots as pheasant and quail burst into the air. When you head to the marsh, settle into your blind, work the call, and drop mallards as they swing, cup, and commit.

Every hunt is built around clean shooting, quick reactions, and the satisfaction of making the right shot at the right moment. Before each hunt begins, you can choose whether to enable aim assist, making Birdshot more accessible for players who want smoother target acquisition. When aim assist is turned on, quail coveys automatically switch targets as they flush, helping you stay locked onto fast‑moving birds. During duck hunts, gamepad players can tap RB to switch between nearby targets, giving you quick control as mallards pass the blind.

Earn score bonuses for accuracy, distance, and bird size, and trigger slow‑motion during clutch opportunities to line up the perfect hit. Players who explore thoroughly may even discover an Easter Egg that unlocks an extended‑mag automatic shotgun, offering a fun twist on traditional upland and waterfowl shooting.

Birdshot focuses on the pure fun of hunting — simple, replay able, and skill‑driven.

Features

  • Third‑person upland hunting for pheasant and quail

  • Mallard duck hunting from a blind in the marsh

  • Optional aim assist toggled before the hunt starts

  • Automatic target switching for quail coveys when aim assist is enabled

  • Tap RB to switch duck targets during waterfowl hunts

  • Dynamic covey flushes and fast‑paced shooting

  • Slow‑motion ability for cinematic, high‑pressure shots

  • Atmospheric fields, prairies, and marsh environments

  • Extended‑mag automatic shotgun Easter Egg

  • No grinding, no filler — just hunting and shooting

Whether you’re chasing a high score or enjoying a quiet morning in the blind, Birdshot delivers the thrill of upland and waterfowl hunting in a clean, focused, and accessible experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5‑8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows‑compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Tested on mid‑range hardware; performance may vary with settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10-/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5‑9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows‑compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for fastest loading and streaming.

content_descriptors.notes: Birdshot contains realistic hunting of wild game animals using firearms. Players can shoot pheasants, quail, and ducks in a natural outdoor environment. There is no gore, dismemberment, or graphic injury shown. No humans, pets, or fantasy creatures are harmed. The game does not include profanity, sexual content, drug use, or other mature themes.
